About.heroSubtitle: Mona Editions is a platform that allows artists to certify their artworks, exhibit them and transfer ownership in a secure and transparent way, thanks to the blockchain.
About.mainBody1: The application is built on smart contracts whose owner can add administrators. These then have the power to authorize new artists to use the platform, which allows for a structured and controlled ecosystem.
About.mainBody2: An artist can register their professional data on the blockchain and create certificates for their artworks.
About.mainBody3: A visitor can browse the various artists and certified artworks.
About.mainBody4: A collector can claim a certificate and view the artworks they own.
About.mainBody5: The focus has been on ease of use: smooth registration and connection, intuitive certificate transfer, an interface designed for artists and art lovers.
About.mainBody6: The smart contracts have been deployed on a Layer 2 to ensure economical use, while maintaining a rigorous level of security. The design of the application is intended to align with the project's identity, remaining minimal and centered on the artwork.
About.manifestoBodyEnd: , exhibit them and transfer ownership in a simple, secure and economical way thanks to the blockchain.
About.techSubtitle: Mona Editions is built on open standards and proven technologies.

Faq.title: Frequently asked
Faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Mona Editions and artwork certification.
Faq.noResultsPrompt: Haven't found the answer to your question?

items.a: Mona Editions is a platform for certifying artworks on the Ethereum blockchain. Each certified artwork receives a permanent digital certificate that is tamper-proof and verifiable by everyone.

The artist creates a digital edition of their artwork (title, year, technique, images…), the data is stored on IPFS and an Ethereum smart contract records the certification. Each certificate is a unique ERC-1155 token.

Yes. Mona Editions uses the Base network, an Ethereum Layer 2 blockchain known for its reliability and low transaction fees. The data recorded on the blockchain is immutable and permanent: it cannot be modified or deleted.

items.q: How to become a certified artist on Mona Editions?
items.a: Artist access is subject to manual validation. Contact us through the contact form specifying your artistic approach. Our team will review your request.

items.q: How many copies can I certify for an artwork?
items.a: You freely choose the edition size at creation (from 1 to 100,000 copies). Each copy is associated with a unique QR code allowing the collector to claim their certificate.
The metadata of your artworks (title, images, description…) is stored on IPFS, a decentralized network. Only the CID (unique identifier) is recorded on the blockchain.

items.q: How do I claim my certificate?
items.a: Scan the QR code provided by the artist with your phone. You will be redirected to the claim page. Sign in or create an account, then claim your certificate in one click.

items.q: Do I need a crypto wallet?
items.a: No. Mona Editions uses Privy, which lets you create a wallet automatically via your email. No technical knowledge required.
Your certificate attests that you own an authentic copy of the artwork, as certified by the artist. It is publicly verifiable on the blockchain at any time.

step1.title: The artist signs up
step1.description: They create their profile (name, bio, photos) and submit their authorization request. Once approved by Mona Editions, they can start certifying.

step2.title: They certify an artwork
step2.description: They describe their artwork, choose the edition size, and receive an Excel file with as many QR codes as copies to distribute.

step3.title: The collector claims
step3.description: The QR code provided with the physical artwork leads to a page where the collector signs the transaction for free. The certificate is theirs forever.

blockchain.title: Base public blockchain
blockchain.description: Certificates are issued on Base, an Ethereum Layer 2 network operated by Coinbase. They exist independently of Mona Editions.

contracts.title: Verified smart contracts
contracts.description: Our source code is public and auditable on Basescan. No hidden modifications are possible.

ipfs.title: Redundant IPFS storage
ipfs.description: Images and descriptions are stored on IPFS, a distributed file network that spreads content across multiple nodes.
